description: A short closed question is posed to the ForegroundModel. Wall-clock latency from question-in to response-ready is measured. v0.1a measures text-path inference (audio stack not yet verified).

fixture_conventions.text_prompts: Closed questions used for latency measurement. Audio modality listed per spec Part 6c; text inference is the v0.1a implementation path as noted in task prompt.
fixture_conventions.n_trials: 20 — enough for stable p50/p95 without excessive GPU time; at n=20 the p95 index (int(0.95*20)=19) is the max element, so p95 equals max

text_prompts: Does the moon orbit the Earth?
Is the Pacific the largest ocean?
